investigation_record.reasoning_summary: The transaction triggered a high-risk ML score of 0.90, but the graph neighborhood shows no multi-hop linked cards and only a single shared device count, failing the threshold for a Distributed Device Ring (RING-02) which requires >=3 distinct accounts. No geo-velocity anomalies (GEO-05) are present as the transaction is online and lacks conflicting physical location data. Historical precedents (CC-0873, CC-0657) indicate that high ML scores in the absence of graph-based fraud indicators often result in benign outcomes after customer verification.

actions_post_evidence.justification: Initiate step-up biometric or in-app push verification to confirm cardholder identity, consistent with handling high-risk ML scores where graph evidence is insufficient for immediate block but warrants verification.
Notify the customer of the unusual transaction activity to prompt immediate confirmation or denial, aligning with historical precedents where customer confirmation cleared similar alerts.
